name: Booking
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; appointment and resource scheduling recurs, and the double-booking race is nearly always present)
description: Slot-based booking for any resource: weekly availability, one-off blackouts, capacity, notice windows, and overlap-safe creation under a row lock. Times are stored UTC and computed in the resource's own timezone so DST does not shift a slot.

instant.label: Instant — a booked slot is confirmed and held immediately

request.label: Request — bookings arrive pending and someone approves them
